messages:
Priya Rao: quick sync — opening a thread for the PR that adds SDK examples for the Optimize toolkit (batching/prefetch/quant). Need a short python + go snippet and one small UX clarification in the docs about `kv_prefetch` behavior.

Tom Chen: I\u2019ll take the Go snippet. Can someone confirm the recommended `max_prefetch=64` is OK for Dedicated clusters?

Amanda Li: For docs UX, can we add one line that warns about increased memory with larger prefetch? e.g., \"prefetch increases KV cache memory; test with sample workload\" :warning:

Priya Rao: yes Amanda  we should add a short note and link to the telemetry dashboard. Also prefer to have a minimal code example inline rather than linking out.

Karl Nguyen: small nit  our style guide prefers `snake_case` param names in Python examples.

Docs Bot: See style guide: https://confluence.redwood/engineering/docs-style#code

Tom Chen: Go snippet draft:
```go
// prefetch example
client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey)
req := redwood.InferRequest{Model: "redwood-opt-1", Prefetch: 32}
res, err := client.Infer(ctx, req)
```

Amanda Li: Python snippet draft:
```python
# minimal prefetch example
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key)
resp = c.infer(model="redwood-opt-1", kv_prefetch=32)
```

Priya Rao: LGTM. Two action items: 1) Tom push go snippet to PR, 2) Amanda add UX warning + link to telemetry dashboard and a one-line perf table. I'll schedule a quick docs review tomorrow 10:30am PT.

Karl Nguyen: tagging @eng-runtime to confirm `max_prefetch=64` is supported without regressions.

Docs Bot: PR checklists: docs lint + example tests required. https://ci.redwood/docs-check

Amanda Li: will do the UX line and add an example test that verifies the snippet runs with `kv_prefetch=8` to keep CI cheap.

Priya Rao: thanks all :thumbsup:
